purpose: Executable ledger for the `selection-multiplicity-reporting` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Multiplicity-control rows prevent route support from being treated as surprising, discovery-grade, or robust after many uncounted trials, forks, candidate presentations, priors, benchmarks, cuts, or pipelines. Correction can only cap or clarify authority, never promote it.

multiplicity_rows.search_space: Effective family of tests, models, decoders, priors, cuts, simulations, pipelines, frames, events, surveys, or candidate presentations explored before the visible FAMILYC-EW-CODE support packet was selected.
multiplicity_rows.effective_number_of_trials: unknown-or-route-local; must be bounded, simulated, preregistered, or explicitly declared uncorrected before surprise/discovery/anomaly language is allowed
multiplicity_rows.correction_or_adjustment_rule: Use the most conservative available route-local control: trial factor / global p-value / FDR / holdout / blind challenge / hierarchical model comparison / or explicit non-discovery cap. Absence of a correction leaves the result capped at its existing state and cannot promote the route.
multiplicity_rows.look_elsewhere_or_forking_paths_risk: local successes may arise from many silently explored paths; route credit must not treat selected positives as if the test family had been fixed in advance
